name: Covington
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Covington, LA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Covington, Louisiana for 2026: 6 family events with dates, times and addresses checked on each host or tourism listing.
lede: Covington celebrates Christmas in its historic downtown, with lighted carol displays, a Trailhead tree lighting and a holiday marketplace at TerraBella Village.
celebrates: The City of Covington anchors the season at the Covington Trailhead with Christmas in Covington and the Lighting of the Christmas Tree on December 12, led by the Lollipop Marching Group parade that brings Santa in, and Covington by Candlelight on December 18. Downtown glows with Covington's Twelve Days of Christmas lighted displays from December 1, and the Northshore Food Bank's Trim the Trailhead trees stand at stop 8. TerraBella Village holds its 17th annual tree lighting and marketplace on December 11 with train rides and Santa photos, and the Lee Lane merchants stage Christmas in the Country on Saturdays through Christmas.
lastyear: The 2026 listings show how long these traditions have run. Christmas in Covington is in its fifth year, so last year's event was the fourth. Trim the Trailhead is in its fourth year, which makes 2025 the third, and TerraBella's tree lighting is its 17th, so last year's was the 16th. Covington's lighted displays and Christmas in the Country return to the same downtown streets. These counts come from the Visit The Northshore tourism listings for each event.
facts: Covington was founded on July 4, 1813 as the Town of Wharton by New Orleans merchant John Wharton Collins, and the state's 1816 charter renamed it Covington, according to the City of Covington's history page. Downtown, called the District of St. John, is laid out around square blocks with interior plots known as ox lots, where farmers and draymen once sheltered their ox teams and wagons. The district is on the National Register of Historic Places, and the Ox Lots are the parking behind downtown shops today.
trains: We found no Christmas train ride in Covington itself, but TerraBella Village's tree lighting on December 11 lists train rides among its family activities. The City's history page says a branch of the East Louisiana Railroad once connected Covington, Abita Springs and Mandeville, and the Tammany Trace rail trail now begins at the Covington Trailhead, according to Louisiana Life. For longer train outings, see our Louisiana Christmas train rides guide.
traditions: The City's Trailhead event with a Lollipop Marching Group parade, Santa's arrival, crafts and the tree lighting.
Twelve lighted carol silhouettes in the downtown historic district, lit dusk to dawn from December 1.
Dozens of decorated trees at the Trailhead that benefit the Northshore Food Bank.
A tree lighting and holiday marketplace with train rides, cookie decorating and Santa photos.
Lee Lane merchants' holiday strolls on the Friday and Saturday after Thanksgiving and every Saturday until Christmas.
kidfact: Covington's downtown blocks have ox lots in the middle, where farmers once kept their ox teams, and today they are parking lots.
faq: The City holds Christmas in Covington and a tree lighting at the Covington Trailhead, adds Covington by Candlelight and lights twelve carol displays downtown. TerraBella Village has its own tree lighting and holiday marketplace, and Lee Lane merchants run Christmas in the Country on Saturdays.
Are there free Christmas events in Covington?
Yes. Christmas in Covington, TerraBella's tree lighting, Covington by Candlelight and the Twelve Days of Christmas displays are all listed as free. Check each listing on this page for times.
Where can kids meet Santa in Covington?

Santa arrives at the Trailhead with the December 12 parade, is at TerraBella Village on December 11, and has photo options at Southern Hotel by appointment and at H.J. Smith and Sons on the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
Is there a train ride in Covington?
TerraBella Village lists train rides at its December 11 tree lighting. There is no train museum in town, so see our Louisiana Christmas train rides guide for others.
Is there a Nutcracker in Covington?
Yes. The Louisiana Academy of Performing Arts and NOLA Contemporary Ballet each have a Nutcracker performance in Covington, and both are listed on this page.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Covington for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (Covington's 12 Days of Christmas Lighted Displays and Trim the Trailhead) through January 6, with TerraBella's Tree Lighting (December 11), Christmas in Covington (December 12), two Nutcracker performances (including December 13) and Covington by Candlelight (December 18) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Covington

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Covington
  • 4 free events: Christmas in Covington, Christmas at TerraBella, Covington by Candlelight and the 12 Days of Christmas displays
  • Meet Santa: Christmas in Covington (December 12) and Christmas at TerraBella (December 11)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Lollipop Marching Group parade and tree lighting (December 12) and the TerraBella tree lighting (December 11)
  • Trains: train rides at Christmas at TerraBella (December 11)
  • Shows: two Nutcracker performances
  • Season: December 1 to January 6
